findings.statement: CXCR2 tops the convergence ranking: six evidence streams, up in all eight cohorts (meta-analysis log2FC [gene=CXCR2; type=expression_meta; source=DATASET:META; layer=rna; log2fc=2.81]), with clinical-stage antagonists such as reparixin and navarixin.

Higher baseline CXCR2 is associated with ustekinumab non-response (BH padj [gene=CXCR2; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=9.69e-6]), but it also separates UNIFI placebo non-responders (padj [gene=CXCR2; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (UNIFI).padj=0.0126]) and the drug-versus-placebo interaction is not significant, so it marks severity rather than a ustekinumab-specific mechanism.

CXCL8 is higher in ustekinumab non-responders (padj [gene=CXCL8; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=0.000102]) but equally in UNIFI placebo non-responders (padj [gene=CXCL8; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (UNIFI).padj=0.0154]); golimumab, infliximab and vedolizumab arms show no significant association, so this is a general severity marker.

OSM is associated with ustekinumab non-response (padj [gene=OSM; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=0.0000264]) and the UNIFI placebo arm does not reach significance (padj [gene=OSM; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (UNIFI).padj=0.116]), yet the interaction test is not significant. In golimumab nothing survives correction (padj [gene=OSM; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.golimumab.padj=0.994]); the infliximab and vedolizumab arms are small and also non-significant.

TREM1 is associated with ustekinumab non-response (padj [gene=TREM1; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=0.0000474]) but also with UNIFI placebo non-response (padj [gene=TREM1; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (UNIFI).padj=0.0234]), with no significant drug-by-placebo interaction: severity, not a drug mechanism.

TNFa pathway activity is higher in non-responders to ustekinumab, golimumab, infliximab and vedolizumab (for infliximab BH padj [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.infliximab.padj=0.000294]), but also in UNIFI placebo non-responders (padj [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (UNIFI).padj=0.00608]); it is a shared severity signal, not specific to anti-TNF.

JAK-STAT activity is higher in ustekinumab non-responders (padj [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=0.0124]) but not in vedolizumab (padj [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.vedolizumab.padj=0.571]); the golimumab arm is also non-significant, and the UNIFI placebo arm is borderline.

Baseline IL23A shows no association with ustekinumab outcome (padj [gene=IL23A; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=0.977]), so target expression itself does not stratify response to ustekinumab, which blocks this cytokine.
ITGB7 expression is not associated with vedolizumab response (padj [gene=ITGB7; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.vedolizumab.padj=0.995]), although this arm is small.

CHRDL2 is the strongest first-in-class candidate (up in eight cohorts, antibody-tractable, stromal, inflammatory fibroblasts the top inflamed cluster) but composition-dependent: only a minority of the increase is retained after composition correction (retained [gene=CHRDL2; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; retained=0.276]). Its highest vital-organ RNA is the largest among the top candidates (nTPM [gene=CHRDL2; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; vital_max_ntpm=42.6]).

CPXM1 is a stromal, antibody-tractable candidate up in eight cohorts, with low vital-organ expression (nTPM [gene=CPXM1; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; vital_max_ntpm=9.1]); it is only partly composition-retained, few UC papers exist, and no drug or functional validation is recorded.

LAX1 is lymphocyte-derived (plasma cells the top inflamed cluster; second dataset assigns plasma rather than T/NK, so lineage did not replicate) and mostly reflects infiltrate (retained [gene=LAX1; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; retained=0.230]), so it marks immune infiltration rather than a tissue-intrinsic change.

XKR9 is the only top candidate classified as intrinsic and epithelial (enterocytes and goblet cells), with most of its increase retained (retained [gene=XKR9; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; retained=0.798]); it is up in only four cohorts, so replication is weaker, and few cells express it.

caveats: Response arms for infliximab (GSE16879) and vedolizumab (GSE73661) are small, so non-significance there is weak evidence of absence.
Most non-response genes tested also separate UNIFI placebo non-responders and no drug-by-placebo interaction is significant, so these are associations with severity, not drug-specific mechanisms.
The PURSUIT placebo arm is small and underpowered.
Discovery candidates are mostly partly composition-driven; none has functional validation or genetic support in this screen, and the vital-organ filter uses RNA only.
Associations are not predictions; no independent validation cohort was used.
